purpose: Validate hard-binding (c2pa.hash.data/bmff, tamper-evident) vs soft-binding (watermark/fingerprint, survives re-encode). Confirms asset byte-hash matches claimed hard-binding hash. Emits TAMPER_EVIDENT / SOFT_BINDING_ONLY / UNBOUND verdict. Terminal stage.
